title: What if you fell into a black hole? 🕳️
subject: blackhole
description:
Would you still jump in? 👇

What happens if you fall into a black hole? NASA's supercomputer simulation shows the fall into a giant one, and why the size of the black hole decides how you die.

Sources: NASA Goddard (2024 black hole visualization, Jeremy Schnittman), NASA APOD Black Hole FAQ (Ted Bunn, UC Berkeley)
tags: what if you fell into a black hole
what happens inside a black hole

scenes.text: You could fall into a black hole and not notice.
NASA simulated falling into one 4.3 million times the Sun's mass.
At the edge, the event horizon, there's no wall. You just drift through.
But here's the strange part. A friend watching from far away never sees you cross. You slow down, turn red and fade.
Inside, gravity stretches you like spaghetti in 12.8 seconds. A small black hole does that before the edge. So pick a big one, because
